high_level_description: The image is a split-screen presentation slide during what appears to be an academic or professional lecture. On the left side of the image: There is a portrait of Irving Biederman, identified as the Harold Dornsife Chair in Neurosciences and Professor of Psychology and Computer Science at USC. Below his portrait, there is a colorful mosaic pattern composed of various small icons representing different categories of visuals. The text on the right side of the slide reads "30K+ Categories of Visuals," indicating a large number of visual categories that can be recognized.
